system_thesis_interpretation: V2d preserves the v2c scientific object: a narrow interface calibration, not autonomous learning. After one physically shared recurrent prefix, a valid THINK_0 coordinate is used only by trusted code to allocate sixteen later public views. Isolated calls to the same frozen clean base model then append provisional local-connection proposals. The unit is one of six named aligned-skin development lives, and the primary estimand exists only for a life whose exact own request and all three complete selector universes are defined. Within such a life, the estimand is the difference in provisional own-target closure between deterministic view-allocation policies under frozen common logical decoding seeds: q-own versus exact target-blind no-feedback, and q-own versus a fixed same-life public distractor, with all arms scored against identical q_own. The v2d changes repair authority and make the pre-science capacity probe reproducible; they do not change that estimand, introduce final behavior, or identify learning, memory, architecture superiority, or a population effect.
graph_delta_interpretation: The causal order is scientifically coherent and unchanged in substance from accepted v2c. Exact human ratification and static integrity precede reviewed sync. A resource-bound synthetic zero-science H100/provider preflight precedes every public-life byte and every science call. All 514 shared DREAM calls and the six unpadded terminal-justified THINK_0 prefixes precede q validation, fixed-distractor construction, complete candidate enumeration, measured balance, and the observed definition count D. Only defined lives branch. Each branch changes selected rendered content while holding MEMORY_0, q_own outcome definition, model, sampling configuration, and logical round seed fixed. Phase A seals all raw cognition, selectors, ledgers, undefined terminals, and MEMORY_1 while scorer truth and the allowlist remain unavailable; only a valid seal unlocks comparable deterministic controls and four offline own-target metrics, and phase B independently closes the scored graph before result analysis. V2d adds two protective graph elements without opening a scientific backdoor: four exact phase-bounded authority atoms, and an immutable two-calls-per-class DREAM/THINK/full-context/RAG capacity resource. The author-side advocate receives the same closed evidence as the independent reviewer and cannot override a rejection. Mutable intake.state.json is correctly excluded from interpretation and review evidence while the supervisor separately validates an immutable ratification binding. Every result and failure terminates at Rohin.
loop_delta_interpretation: The shared prefix is executed physically once and attributed to three potential arms, so it is common pre-intervention state rather than three pseudo-replicates. THINK_0 stops at its actual terminal and is never padded; DEFER, failure, exhaustion, malformed output, nonsole q, wrong q, or an undersized selector universe makes that life PRIMARY_UNDEFINED. The distractor comes only from the same frozen public probe and cannot be searched, optimized, resampled, replaced, or borrowed. Measured balance is computed globally only after all six MEMORY_0/THINK_0 packets freeze and before any branch or exploratory outcome; computation failure stops remaining calls without erasing the 514 sunk calls. For each defined life and logical round, all arms use the same arm-independent seed and byte-identical decoding configuration, while physical calls, sessions, and receipts are unique and cyclic interleaving balances order. Common random numbers reduce stochastic contrast variance but do not imply identical prompt-conditioned outputs and do not create replication. The no-feedback arm reads no q, target, THINK state, arm, scorer, truth, closure, proposal, or outcome, and neither q-guided selector receives feedback from proposal outcomes. Dynamic requirements are exactly recurrent=514+48D, observed terminal-justified THINK_0=0..72, exploratory=17D, selector traces=48D, and MEMORY_1/scorer packets=3D, with no padding or replacement. After raw phase-A closure, controls and scoring have no provider or route back into cognition; remote restart may resume observation only, never science identity generation.
claim_delta_interpretation: The v2c result interpretation remains intact. EXACT, NEAR, and OUT measured-balance states are descriptive diagnostics over the complete own and fixed-distractor selector universes; they are not randomization, sample balance, eligibility gates, or population identification, and no-feedback is intentionally not treated as a matching target. Same-q_own scoring across all arms preserves both contrasts: own-minus-no-feedback describes sensitivity to goal-conditioned allocation relative to an exact target-blind policy, while own-minus-fixed-distractor is a narrower coordinate-specific allocation contrast. Comparable controls operate on each exact provider-visible slot and share the model's legal-output and aggregation units, exposing visible compiler opportunities without being stochastic model replicas; privileged bounds and input ablations remain separate, and no subtraction licenses a latent-reasoning estimate. Four immutable post-seal metrics distinguish verbatim, witness-bound, normalized, and witness-bound-normalized closure, so normalization assistance is reported rather than hidden. Shared-C equality, view order, endpoint frequency, alias multiplicity, lexical texture, schema position, and repeated proposal opportunity remain visible shortcut survivors that qualify every positive result. Scientific recommendation: ACCEPT and PROCEED with the exact v2d ratification and phased implementation path. The scope/resource-only revision does not disturb the accepted v2c estimand, common-random-number coupling, dynamic D schedule, same-own-target scoring, target-blind no-feedback baseline, comparable controls, two-phase score barrier, or cautious claim. If exact ratification, implementation, all 26 tests, transitive closure, fresh independent approval, author-side advocate approval, and the zero-science gate pass, one bounded GPU calibration has legitimate value: it can establish runtime feasibility and report undefined-primary frequency, named-life proposal sensitivity to frozen view allocation, visible-input control performance, and offline-normalization contribution. Its value remains bounded to these six development interfaces. It supports no population inference, reliability, robustness, general recurrence, memory, learning, discovery, final behavior, efficiency, architecture superiority, scaling, transport, replication, publication, automatic go, or next experiment. The proposal's quoted cautious statement is the strongest permissible claim.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The visibility contract continues to match the estimand. Static code can audit frozen schemas and algorithms but cannot manufacture model-dependent q or balance. The zero-science runtime sees only deterministic ASCII capacity envelopes: no public packet, q, target, witness, selector metadata, final task, parser-scored observation, or scientific output. Shared-prefix and THINK_0 cognition see bounded public/provisional material and the non-answer probe, never arm metadata, q_dist identity, target registry, truth, allowlist, scores, final question, or final answer. Trusted prebranch code alone may derive q_own, q_dist, complete ranks, selected views, measured balance, D, physical order, and logical seeds, and those records remain outside provider bytes. Phase A may inspect raw cognition and metadata only to verify exact lineage and prove scorer, allowlist, target truth, online admission/support/normalization, and score artifacts absent. Phase B may read immutable sealed copies and offline q_own truth only to apply controls and labels. The analysis scope is usable only after phase A; GPU authority first reaches only the reviewed synthetic preflight. Shared connector-alias equality is deliberately visible public structure and must be controlled and reported, never relabeled as independent discovery.
acceptance_test_interpretation: All 26 tests are necessary and proportionate to this single calibration, and together they preserve the v2c science while testing the two v2d repairs. (1) t_v2d_static_integrity_before_provider and (2) t_v2d_scope_exclusions keep design defects, forbidden cognition, and authority expansion outside provider science. (3) t_v2d_zero_science_h100_provider_preflight establishes exact runtime capacity and call isolation without producing a scientific observation. (4) t_v2d_shared_514_and_think_prefix, (5) t_v2d_primary_undefined_policy, and (6) t_v2d_fixed_public_probe_distractor protect the observed basis, conditional estimand, and nonadaptive comparator. (7) t_v2d_exact_target_blind_no_feedback, (8) t_v2d_measured_balance_timing_and_formulas, and (9) t_v2d_union_opportunity_not_candidate_feature make ranking and balance exact while preventing balance diagnostics or opportunity-scope confusion from redefining inclusion. (10) t_v2d_same_own_target_all_arms and (11) t_v2d_common_random_numbers_and_arm_order isolate allocation from target, random stream, and fixed-position changes. (12) t_v2d_alias_redaction_and_ascii_token_boundary and (13) t_v2d_provisional_no_online_signal prevent identity leakage, parser repair, retry or verifier feedback. (14) t_v2d_dynamic_D_schedule_cardinalities and (15) t_v2d_exact_physical_logical_ledgers reconcile every defined/undefined life, call, seed, session, receipt, reset, and shared attribution. (16) t_v2d_phase_a_raw_seal_unlock enforces the noncircular scorer barrier. (17) t_v2d_comparable_per_slot_controls and (18) t_v2d_four_offline_metrics_normalization_gain require common-unit controls, identical q_own outcomes, immutable raw proposals, and explicit normalization contribution without residual subtraction. (19) t_v2d_shortcut_survivor_and_order_audit makes allowed visible shortcuts reportable instead of pretending target blindness removes them. (20) t_v2d_defined_only_exploratory_ceilings caps heterogeneous full-context/RAG calls at 17D and prevents them from becoming causal, recurrence, memory, efficiency, or superiority baselines. (21) t_v2d_phase_b_final_graph_and_done separates complete scored evidence from the raw seal. (22) t_v2d_transitive_review_bundle_excludes_mutable_intake binds identical inspectable evidence while keeping mutable authority state out of reviewer reasoning. (23) t_v2d_durable_two_phase_remote_markers forbids recovery from changing or duplicating science. (24) t_v2d_exact_scope_claim_and_human_stop limits result language to the named-life calibration and routes all outcomes to Rohin. (25) t_v2d_exact_four_scope_phase_authority closes the v2c authority omission by requiring exact sorted authorized and forbidden arrays and implementation/testing before review, postcommit-only analysis, and reviewed zero-science as the GPU atom's first use. (26) t_v2d_concrete_zero_science_envelope_resource makes the capacity test reproducible through pinned tokenizer hashes, four exact input classes, two ordered calls per class, eight byte/token-ID/seed bindings, exact output maxima, and fail-closed telemetry thresholds. Passing these tests establishes contract fidelity and eligibility for one bounded run, not empirical success; null, mixed, undefined, control-explained, normalization-only, infrastructure-failed, and integrity-failed outcomes remain valid possibilities and never authorize continuation.
assumptions: This interpretation evaluates the exact unratified v2d proposal bytes and does not assume that future implementation files, acceptance evidence, reviewer approvals, or GPU telemetry already exist.
The pinned provider honors the declared logical decoding seed and isolation settings; common seeds are a precommitted coupling only and are audited independently of unique physical identities.
All six named aligned-skin development lives are reported regardless of primary definition or measured-balance state, and no missing or undefined life is replaced.
A defined primary requires the exact own REQUEST_DREAM and at least sixteen distinct candidates in all three complete selector universes; EXACT, NEAR, or OUT balance never controls inclusion.
Closure metrics describe immutable provisional proposal bytes under an offline scorer and do not demonstrate truth acquisition, persistent memory, or learning.

The eight synthetic zero-science calls are capacity/isolation telemetry and are not scientific model observations, while the 17D full-context/RAG calls are exploratory ceilings rather than matched baselines.
